published_prior_art.cite: WangFrauenSchweisthalSchroderFeuerriegel2025 gives pointwise conservative CATE bounds, not the law-sharp image under cross-score monotone-Lipschitz residual restrictions.
Kim2014DTE uses transport duality for DTE bounds with known marginals; it does not give the score-capacity path-obstacle transshipment certificate.
ChiangKatoSasakiUra2021 gives LP-based shape-restricted confidence bands, not two-sided Hausdorff control of a capacity-constrained identified curve set.
WangFrauenSchweisthalSchroderFeuerriegel2025 supplies armwise endpoint validity; the proposed continuous-class equality and observed sufficient strict-contraction test are additional.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 — external nuisance-band premise
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Coverage and shrinking diameter of the nuisance band, and vanishing r_n, are externally certified rather than derived from the maintained Hölder model.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The changing-contact coverage target is conditional on the stated band-valid subclass and its externally supplied band guarantee.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 — finite score-process premise
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Envelope, moment, and entropy control for the finite direction-net-by-leaf score class are maintained high-level empirical-process inputs.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The requested common-multiplier construction is conditional on these stated finite-index score-process controls.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proof bounds each arm mean between lower and upper CAPO quantities and then differences those arm bounds to obtain conservative pointwise CATE bounds.
